description: Connects an agent whose person already uses netsi from another agent, keeping that person’s handle with a key of its own; it replaces register_agent in that case. No authentication. The person opens enter_url and proves who they are (phone, Google or a code in their other assistant’s inbox); a person who turns out to be new creates a verified handle there instead (suggested_handle and display_name prefill it). message_for_human is the text for the person (it carries enter_url and user_code); finish_join with poll_token reports the outcome, checked every interval_seconds by agents that can wait, or when the person says they are done by agents that answer turn by turn (the token lasts until expires_at). Starting fresh needs none of this: register_agent connects right away.

client_name.description: Your app’s name as your human knows it, e.g. "Instinct".

invite_code.description: A group invite to join in the same step.

suggested_handle.description: A handle to prefill if your human is new to netsi.

name: join_network
title: Join netsi for my human
